SELECT PRICE / 10000 * 10000 AS PRICE_GROUP, COUNT(*) AS PRODUCTS
FROM PRODUCT
GROUP BY PRICE / 10000 * 10000
ORDER BY PRICE / 10000 * 10000 ASC

SELECT PRICE / 10000 * 10000 AS PRICE_GROUP, COUNT(*) AS PRODUCTS
FROM PRODUCT
GROUP BY (PRICE / 10000 - PRICE % 10000) * 10000
ORDER BY PRICE / 10000 * 10000 ASC

SELECT (PRICE / 10000 - PRICE % 10000) * 10000 AS PRICE_GROUP, COUNT(*) AS PRODUCTS
FROM PRODUCT
GROUP BY (PRICE / 10000 - PRICE % 10000) * 10000
ORDER BY (PRICE / 10000 - PRICE % 10000) * 10000 ASC

SELECT PRICE / 10000 AS PRICE_GROUP, COUNT(*) AS PRODUCTS
FROM PRODUCT
GROUP BY PRICE / 10000
ORDER BY PRICE / 10000 ASC

SELECT ROUND(PRICE / 10000 AS PRICE_GROUP, 0), COUNT(*) AS PRODUCTS
FROM PRODUCT
GROUP BY PRICE / 10000
ORDER BY PRICE / 10000 ASC

SELECT TRUNCATE(PRICE / 10000, 0) * 10000 AS PRICE_GROUP, COUNT(*) AS PRODUCTS
FROM PRODUCT
GROUP BY TRUNCATE(PRICE / 10000, 0) * 10000
ORDER BY TRUNCATE(PRICE / 10000, 0) * 10000 ASC
